captions.detailed: This 3D model features a compact floor training pump with a low, rectangular black base and a shorter, dark blue cylindrical barrel. Mounted near the front of the base is a round pressure gauge with a white face, black tick marks, and a black indicating needle, flanked by a small red cylindrical pressure-release button. A black T-handle is connected to a silver-grey piston rod protruding from the top of the barrel. The handle and rod slide vertically along the barrel axis, the gauge needle rotates on its central pivot, and the small red button can be pushed linearly.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact training floor pump with a low black rectangular base, a short dark blue barrel, and a black T-handle on a silver piston rod. Integrate a round pressure gauge with a white face and a black needle on the base, along with a small red pressure-release button. Ensure the handle slides vertically, the gauge needle rotates, and the red button moves prismatically.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a box primitive, adding a cylinder for the pump barrel, and small boxes for foot-rests. Model the pressure gauge using a cylinder for the housing, a thin cylinder for the white face, and a thin box for the needle. Create the T-handle from intersecting cylinders (the crossbar and the joint) and the piston rod as a silver cylinder. Define three articulations: a prismatic joint for the handle/rod assembly along the Z-axis, a revolute joint for the gauge needle on the Z-axis, and a prismatic joint for the red button along the Y-axis.
